description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for collateral-related endpoints in the Fineract project. It defines schema classes for API responses related to collateral retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, including nested classes for collateral type and currency details.

classes.name: CollateralsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing Swagger schema models for collateral-related API responses.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdCollateralsResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving collateral details associated with a loan, including nested classes for collateral type and currency.

classes.name: GetCollateralTypeResponse
classes.description: Represents the type information of a collateral, including id and name.

classes.name: GetCollateralCurrencyResponse
classes.description: Represents currency details for collateral, including code, name, decimal places, display symbol, and label.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdCollateralsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response received after adding a new collateral to a loan, mainly providing the resource ID.

classes.name: PutLoansLoanIdCollateralsCollateralIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for updating collateral details, including the loan ID, resource ID, and changes.

classes.name: DeleteLoansLoanIdCollateralsCollateralIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a collateral, providing loan ID and resource ID.
